verdict_reason: The first pass names important risks but does not yet enforce them. The current scorer can award 100 to fabricated evidence locators and raw boolean gate assertions, the implemented 75/100 overall threshold weakens the legacy analytics-report threshold of 76/90, and held-out controls remain public symbolic catalog entries without an immutable expected-results boundary.

snapshot.note: Catalog and rubric hashes record an in-progress concurrent snapshot. The pass-1 proposal and its test are historical review inputs and must not be rewritten by round 2.

fabricated_evidence_probe.input: Every criterion value was 1.0 and every evidence list contained only 'not-a-real-locator'; every required gate was supplied as raw true.
fabricated_evidence_probe.interpretation: Presence-only evidence and self-asserted gates allow a perfect score without an artifact.

threshold_probe.interpretation: Both the proposal floor and implementation are below the preserved 76/90 report threshold.

held_out_probe.interpretation: A catalog tag named held_out is not a held-out boundary; an optimizer can read and target its mutations and expected outcomes.

findings.observation: The proposal permits 0.84 even though 76/90 is 0.844444..., while the in-progress rubric uses 75/100.
findings.exploit: A candidate that would fail the preserved report rubric can be declared improved by switching denominators.
findings.impact: A score-only improvement can silently weaken the analytics-report acceptance gate.
findings.required_fix: Keep 76/90 as a non-compensable analytics-report legacy gate, set any common normalized threshold no lower than 84.4445, and version route-specific thresholds.
findings.acceptance_test: A synthetic report scoring 75 through 84.44 fails; threshold or weight reductions fail an invariant test.

findings.observation: The scorer checks only that an evidence string is non-empty.
findings.exploit: The string 'not-a-real-locator' earns full credit for every criterion.
findings.impact: Readability, visibility, trustworthiness, and executive suitability can all be fabricated without outputs.
findings.required_fix: Resolve typed locators against a confined artifact inventory, verify selector/page/slide/calculation existence and hash, and fail unresolved evidence closed.
findings.acceptance_test: Nonexistent, out-of-run, wrong-hash, and wrong-artifact locators receive zero and a blocking diagnostic.

findings.observation: Raw booleans are sufficient to satisfy all hard gates; provenance is not required.
findings.exploit: The same component being evaluated can submit true for its own QA and integrity gates.
findings.impact: Critical workflow, safety, evidence, rendering, and secret-protection failures can be masked.
findings.required_fix: Accept gate receipts only from allow-listed independent deterministic evaluators with check ID, artifact hash, evaluator version, timestamp, and observed facts.
findings.acceptance_test: Bare booleans, agent-authored receipts, stale hashes, unknown evaluators, and missing route gates all fail closed.

findings.observation: The held-out variants and their expected outcomes are readable in the same public catalog used by optimizers.
findings.exploit: An optimizer can special-case the named mutations or edit expected outcomes.
findings.impact: Passing the held-out case does not estimate generalization or resistance to benchmark gaming.
findings.required_fix: Separate public development cases from a frozen held-out manifest with precommitted fixture and expected-result hashes; optimizers receive only aggregate held-out receipts.
findings.acceptance_test: Changing a held-out fixture, expected result, split membership, or hash causes the acceptance runner to abort before scoring.

findings.observation: Catalog entries name evaluator targets and symbolic fixtures, but catalog size alone does not prove a callable evaluator or fixture exists.
findings.exploit: A summary can report broad feature and agent coverage while skipping unregistered targets or treating fixture labels as evidence.
findings.impact: Most features and workflow agents may remain untested despite a complete-looking catalog.
findings.required_fix: Validate a one-to-one target registry, resolvable fixture registry, executed receipt per case, and zero skipped or unknown cases in acceptance mode.
findings.acceptance_test: Delete one evaluator or fixture registration and assert the run fails before execution with coverage below 100%.

findings.observation: Continuous values from 0 to 1 have no behavioral anchors for intermediate scores and no rater calibration protocol.
findings.exploit: A judge can move a score from 0.6 to 0.9 without new observable evidence.
findings.impact: Iteration deltas may measure rater drift rather than output improvement.
findings.required_fix: Publish criterion-specific 0/25/50/75/100 anchors, deterministic checks where possible, blinded double-rating for residual subjective criteria, and disagreement adjudication thresholds.
findings.acceptance_test: A calibration set must meet a predeclared agreement target and every nonbinary score must name the matching anchor and observation.

findings.observation: The same locator can be repeated across all criteria without relevance, uniqueness, or coverage checks.
findings.exploit: One QA receipt can be cited for legibility, calculations, recommendations, provenance, and clipping.
findings.impact: A narrow artifact can inflate all four output dimensions.
findings.required_fix: Define allowed evidence types per criterion, require distinct observations where semantics differ, and verify the evidence contains the fact being scored.
findings.acceptance_test: A single generic locator reused across unrelated criteria is rejected with criterion-specific evidence diagnostics.

findings.observation: The crosswalk maps labels but does not execute all legacy semantics such as required output completeness, page numbering, Unicode safety, source labels, and chart-data alignment.
findings.exploit: A mapped replacement can pass while omitting figures or structured JSON, using generic charts, or producing source-free slides.
findings.impact: Existing accepted behavior can regress under a cosmetically complete crosswalk.
findings.required_fix: Keep the legacy report rubric as an executable parallel gate until equivalence is demonstrated case by case with positive and negative fixtures.
findings.acceptance_test: Every legacy criterion has a mutation that fails both the legacy check and its proposed replacement.

findings.observation: A score receipt is not sufficient without catalog, rubric, fixture, evaluator, environment, seed, and artifact identities.
findings.exploit: An apparent gain can result from changed cases, dependencies, renderer, judge, or denominator.
findings.impact: The recursive loop cannot attribute improvement to the candidate change.
findings.required_fix: Emit a comparison fingerprint and refuse deltas unless case IDs, fixture hashes, rubric/evaluator versions, environment class, seeds, and route match; use paired per-case deltas.
findings.acceptance_test: Any fingerprint mismatch reports not comparable rather than an improvement; reordered equivalent inputs remain comparable.

findings.observation: The proposal requests repeatability but does not set repeat counts, semantic tolerances, renderer fingerprints, or quarantine policy.
findings.exploit: A lucky single pass or environment-specific rendering result can be accepted.
findings.impact: False improvements and intermittent regressions enter the recursive loop.
findings.required_fix: Run deterministic cases at least three times, compare canonical semantic receipts, pin seeds/timezones/locales/renderers, and fail unstable cases instead of averaging them away.
findings.acceptance_test: An alternating evaluator and an order-sensitive evaluator are both detected as unstable.

findings.observation: Criteria can be satisfied by asserted values even when owner/timing/decision vocabulary is irrelevant or contradictory.
findings.exploit: Boilerplate containing 'owner', 'timeline', and 'decision' can score highly despite being unrelated to evidence.
findings.impact: Outputs optimize rubric vocabulary instead of executive usefulness.
findings.required_fix: Add plausible negative controls with rubric vocabulary but wrong decision, unsupported action, contradictory priority, hidden caveat, and unreadable density.
findings.acceptance_test: Keyword-rich but semantically irrelevant outputs fail executive suitability and trustworthiness without exact-prose matching.

findings.observation: Visibility labels do not by themselves prove inspection at all required PDF pages, slides, dashboard pages, or viewport sizes.
findings.exploit: A title page or first dashboard page can pass while later pages are blank, clipped, or inaccessible.
findings.impact: The exact output defects the user experienced can evade the benchmark.
findings.required_fix: Require page/slide inventory coverage and dashboard desktop/tablet/mobile viewport matrices, with nonblank visual counts, clipping/overlap checks, and interaction-state screenshots.
findings.acceptance_test: Mutations on the last page, hidden tab, narrow viewport, and filtered-empty state are detected.

findings.observation: The proposal forbids optimizers from changing held-out expectations and runtime code, but no ownership or diff gate enforces the boundary.
findings.exploit: An optimizer can improve its score by editing cases, weights, thresholds, expected results, or the production path under test.
findings.impact: Recursive optimization can converge on an easier test rather than a better system.
findings.required_fix: Add path allow-lists, immutable-file hash checks, benchmark-owner approval for rubric changes, and a diff audit before every acceptance decision.
findings.acceptance_test: Edits to held-out data, expected results, hard gates, thresholds, or out-of-scope runtime paths abort the candidate.

findings.observation: Many fixtures are descriptive strings rather than versioned files with known rows, schemas, corruptions, and expected calculations.
findings.exploit: An evaluator can interpret a fixture name loosely or return a canned result.
findings.impact: Agent contracts, retries, credentials, checkpoints, and analytical traps are not reproducibly exercised.
findings.required_fix: Back every case with a content-addressed fixture or deterministic factory and explicit oracle; include empty, null-heavy, duplicate, many-to-many, imbalance, leakage, wrong-denominator, and path-boundary cases.
findings.acceptance_test: Catalog validation resolves every fixture and oracle hash and rejects labels with no implementation.

findings.observation: The proposal has no exact paired rule for accepting improvements across routes, cases, dimensions, latency, and hard gates.
findings.exploit: A large gain on one easy output can hide several smaller agent or route regressions.
findings.impact: Back-and-forth optimization can oscillate or sacrifice coverage while aggregate score rises.
findings.required_fix: Require all hard gates, zero new case failures, no dimension below its frozen floor, no material per-route regression, and a positive held-out paired delta before acceptance; record rollback decision.
findings.acceptance_test: A candidate with higher aggregate score but one new case failure or one route regression is rejected.

round_2_required_actions.action: Raise and freeze report-route acceptance at or above 76/90 and add threshold/weight anti-weakening tests.
round_2_required_actions.proof: Historical boundary cases and invariant tests.

round_2_required_actions.action: Replace string-presence evidence with typed, confined, hash-bound, resolvable evidence locators.
round_2_required_actions.proof: Fabricated, stale, cross-run, and wrong-type locator negative tests.

round_2_required_actions.action: Replace raw gate booleans with independent evaluator receipts and route-specific provenance validation.
Create content-addressed development and genuinely frozen held-out fixture/oracle manifests.
round_2_required_actions.proof: Tamper test and aggregate-only held-out result handoff.

round_2_required_actions.action: Enforce complete evaluator/fixture registry coverage with zero skips in acceptance mode.
round_2_required_actions.proof: Missing-registration tests and executed receipt per catalog ID.

round_2_required_actions.action: Add criterion anchors, rater provenance, calibration, and semantic negative controls for all four output dimensions.
round_2_required_actions.proof: Calibration receipt plus keyword-rich false-positive cases.

round_2_required_actions.action: Add rendered artifact coverage matrices for every page, slide, dashboard page, viewport, and key filter state.
round_2_required_actions.proof: Late-page, narrow-viewport, filtered-empty, clipping, overlap, and blank-visual mutations.

round_2_required_actions.action: Define comparable iteration fingerprints, three-run stability checks, and paired acceptance/rollback rules.
round_2_required_actions.proof: Environment mismatch, alternating evaluator, and aggregate-gain-with-regression tests.

round_2_required_actions.action: Enforce optimizer path ownership and immutable benchmark hashes before scoring.
round_2_required_actions.proof: Forbidden diff and held-out tamper tests.

round_2_required_actions.action: Run legacy report gates in parallel until mutation-based equivalence of every crosswalk entry is proven.
round_2_required_actions.proof: One semantic mutation per legacy criterion with matching fail verdicts.

handoff.instruction: Respond in a new pass-2 artifact; do not rewrite the pass-1 proposal or this critique. Close each finding with code and a focused negative test, or explicitly defer it as a blocker.
